versions.changelog:
qmds 1.0.0

- Initial release with comprehensive support for local search and indexing CLI using BM25 + vectors + rerank (MCP mode).
- Provides access to over 50 models for chat, image generation, video generation, text-to-speech, speech-to-text, music, document parsing, web search, email, and SMS.
- Unified API for multi-provider support including Bedrock, OpenAI, Vertex, ElevenLabs, Replicate, Minimax, and more.
- Includes smart routing for automatic model selection based on price or quality.
- Extensive usage examples and parameter documentation for all major capabilities.
